# Approved commit author and committer identities for this repository.
#
# The gate in test/identity-audit.test.ts fails closed on any author or
# committer email outside this list, and on any newly added absolute home path.
#
# Every address here is one that actually appears, and the note beside it says
# where from. Adding an address should be a deliberate act with a stated reason,
# not an inheritance from whichever repository this was scaffolded from.

# The maintainer's GitHub noreply address, used for every hand-made commit.
1153461+unbraind@users.noreply.github.com

# GitHub's committer for merges made through the web UI.
noreply@github.com

# The GitHub Actions bot, which authors the release commit.
41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com

# Dependabot's public GitHub noreply address.
49699333+dependabot[bot]@users.noreply.github.com

# The maintainer's public GitHub account identity.
#
# This appears in CI even though no commit here is authored with it. A
# `pull_request` workflow checks out `refs/pull/N/merge`, whose tip is a merge
# commit GitHub fabricates for the run and attributes to the account that opened
# the pull request. That commit is never pushed and never lands on main - but it
# is HEAD while the gate runs, so the gate audits it.
#
# It is listed rather than excluded because "skip merge commits" would also stop
# auditing real ones, and a merge commit carries an identity like any other. The
# address is already an intentional public identity across this fleet's history.
stefan@preu.at
